name: Meta Model API
desc: OpenAI-compatible API for Meta's open models.
desc_zh: Meta 面向开发者的模型接口
solves: Every vendor ships its own request shape. These model families come through an OpenAI-compatible endpoint, so the adapter already written keeps working.
solves_zh: 每家厂商的请求格式都不一样。这几个模型家族走兼容 OpenAI 的接口，已经写好的适配层还能继续用。
best_for: You already speak the OpenAI API and want Meta's models without new glue.
best_for_zh: 已经熟悉 OpenAI API，想用 Meta 的模型又不想再写适配层。
notes: Meta's successor to the Llama API — an OpenAI- and Anthropic-SDK-compatible endpoint at api.meta.ai, not a proprietary wrapper. 首次公开发布日期精度：month-only 来源：https://www.eesel.ai
